runtime.stop_note: Single-shot and idempotent; compute_class ZERO, expected wall clock under 120 s, dominated by about a dozen Europe PMC calls spaced 0.6 s apart. The citing review is now read from a local pinned file, so the only network dependence is candidate resolution and any primary full text. Resume is disallowed because a partial run would leave an OUTPUT_MANIFEST.sha256 that does not describe a complete set of outputs: re-run from the start into a clean output directory instead. A failed blocking control ENDS the task - no primary table is written, but TASK_REPORT.md (TASK_STATE: VOID, SCIENTIFIC_OUTCOME: NOT_APPLICABLE), logs/run_log.json and OUTPUT_MANIFEST.sha256 are still written, no consumable output is declared, and the process exits 2. The successor is a NEW task id, never a v2 in place (WORKING_RULES section 6b rule 2). If www.ebi.ac.uk is unreachable, A23d_POS_known_record fails and the task stops before any primary retrieval. Iteration budget is 1: on exhausting it without meeting the criterion the task terminates INCONCLUSIVE and escalates rather than trying a second identity rule.
